# Aaliyan Ahmad

> Personal portfolio of Aaliyan Ahmad, also known as Ibn Ishfaq, a software engineer, founder, product builder and digital creator based in Lahore, Pakistan.

Aaliyan works across backend engineering, web and mobile products, digital systems, Vector Labs, and content creation.

## Portfolio

- [Home](https://www.aaliyanahmad.tech/): Overview, experience, selected work, services and contact.
- [GetProof.tech](https://www.aaliyanahmad.tech/work/getproof): Shipped digital agreement platform with verified digital timelines.
- [TaskConnect](https://www.aaliyanahmad.tech/work/taskconnect): Two-sided local odd-jobs marketplace connecting clients with taskers (Final Year Project).
- [Dashboards & Internal Systems](https://www.aaliyanahmad.tech/work/dashboards-internal-systems): High-performance administrative dashboards, telemetry monitors, and operational tools.
- [ApkaMuaalij](https://www.aaliyanahmad.tech/work/apkamuaalij): Production backend engineering and platform systems work for ApkaMuaalij healthcare.
- [Dental Clinic](https://www.aaliyanahmad.tech/work/dental-clinic): Modern dental clinic web experience with online consultation booking.
- [Finance Manager](https://www.aaliyanahmad.tech/work/finance-manager): Personal finance tracking and cashflow analytics software.
